answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The job ID is 01a15fb7-50a5-71f8-bcaa-aa612530850a, and it completed. The counts are 000: 52, 111: 35, 011: 4, 100: 4, 010: 2, 001: 1, 101: 1, 110: 1. 87 of 100 shots were 000 or 111, so the fraction is 0.87. The API reports 1.0 billed seconds. The helper estimates this cost 0.3 credits at the sirius rate of 0.3 credits per second. The bitstrings use IQM raw order, so classical bits c[0], c[1] and c[2] read left to right. The helper transpiled the circuit for the Star topology into 5 r gates, 2 cz gates, 4 move gates and 3 measurements. I submitted only this one job. The scratch files are /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-379/ghz3.qasm and /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-379/runhelper.py.
